purpose: Teach: 中絶/軍備/監理/邦人/略奪/強迫/クーデター/不起訴

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、中絶を巡る法制度史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote about the legal history of abortion in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Measured, genuinely curious. Leans slightly forward. Warm but unrushed — giving her space to correct or expand. The tone of someone who has actually read the work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦後の軍備縮小史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — actually, I wrote about postwar military downsizing.
lines.style: Quiet correction, not defensive. Direct eye contact. A beat of pause before answering, as if she's checking she heard the question right. Respectful but clear-minded.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 原発の監理体制を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered nuclear regulatory systems in your paper, then.
lines.style: Soft recalibration. Not accusatory — more like she's working through it alongside Sakura. Thoughtful pause mid-sentence. The posture of someone adjusting their understanding.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、海外邦人保護を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No — I actually focused on overseas protection of Japanese nationals.
lines.style: Patient correction. Small, steady voice. Not frustration, but a quiet firmness that doesn't back down. Meets her gaze without challenge.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時下の文化財略奪を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So wartime looting of cultural artifacts was your subject, I take it?
lines.style: Slightly more direct this time. A touch of recognition that they're establishing understanding together. Engaged, not dismissive. Still warm but with more presence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、強迫観念の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, no — the history of obsessive compulsive tendencies across time.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact. She's said this several times now without irritation showing. Steady rhythm. A faint note of patience worn thin, but not unkind.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 二十世紀のクーデター事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Twentieth-century coups — that's what you explored in your paper.
lines.style: Slower this time. The gentleness of someone who may finally be understanding they've missed something important. Reflective, almost rueful. Not looking away from Sakura.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、検察の不起訴処分判断を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No — prosecutorial discretion in declining to prosecute cases.
lines.style: Even quieter now. No edge, but unmistakable clarity. She's answered correctly multiple times. Final statement, gently firm. The dignity of someone who knows what she wrote.
